scope: Static independent review against retained 0x1800636c0 assembly and parser test/validation sources; no new test run or native/target execution.
checks: The characters count is cleared before the pointer count is initialized to 1, and the program argument pointer is published before copying.
Program-name quote toggling, SPACE/TAB separation and terminator overwrite match 0x180063708..0x180063778; program-name quotes are not emitted.
Program-name provider call follows count increment and byte copy, including the NUL byte. MOVSX semantics are preserved by bit_cast<int8_t>.
DBCS trail bytes are copied as opaque data; syntax tests use the original lead byte. Provider nonzero tests use the full 32-bit result.
Subsequent arguments implement 32-bit backslash counts, even/odd quote escaping, paired quote behavior only when already quoted, and ordinary SPACE/TAB separation.

Later-argument character count increments occur after the provider call, with the extra DBCS count increment before trail copy; argument pointers/counts and final null sentinel follow the original order.
Empty output spans independently model null pointer outputs; declared span/input/trail/output exceptions are new bounded-model guards and are not claimed to be original exceptions.
Provider immutability and stable, disjoint storage are explicit contracts. Exception unwinding/SEH and native command-line acquisition remain outside this normal-flow source.

Inspected vectors cover argv0 special handling, empty/unmatched quotes, quote/backslash runs, DBCS syntax-looking trails, signed bytes, all four output modes, inverse-encoder properties, order observations and explicit guard cases.
limitations: Fixtures do not establish native locale selection or runtime DLL equivalence. The finite property corpus is not an exhaustive proof for all command lines.
